blocked_policy: Retain failed/partial run with raw errors; continue independent next profile in a fresh process; no fallback, retraining, parser repair or test-driven tuning
cache_state: Warm original unmodified base weights retrieved for H21, moved within remote /tmp
cost_limits: Same physical GPU but fixed temporal order and warm cache confound timing
Whole GPU0 plus current process measurements; allocated idle second T4 is not included in GPU0 process cost
Sampled maxima are not continuous hardware peaks; unique physical cache file content is not allocated disk blocks or a monetary price
execution: One fresh process per mode/allocation, same qualified GPU0 physical UUID and unchanged stored task order
model_choice: Fixed retained research adapter across all modes; no serving/adoption selection
precision_scope: FP16/int8/NF4 base model with the same original F32 LoRA; not a claim that every tensor uses one dtype
rationale: Measure cost and whether quantization preserves the observed small task/component gains; poor Arabic and overall success preclude deployment
task_scope: H19 two dev/two test application families, shared workflow templates; ten repeated standalone diagnostic probes, not new untouched test cases
